description: District Secretariat - Ratnapura - pilgrimages Ordinance Sri Pada Pilgrimage Season -2025/2026
categorisation: The gazette content is a formal notification issued under the authority of the Pilgrimages Ordinance (Chapter 175). It announces the dates for the Sri Pada pilgrimage season and, more importantly, details and enforces a comprehensive set of regulations (covering construction, sanitation, vending, environmental protection, etc.) for the duration of the season. This constitutes the publication and application of regulatory rules under an existing legal ordinance, fitting the definition of a Legal/Regulatory Gazette. It does not involve government personnel/structure changes (Types 1-3) or other specialized administrative matters like land or commerce.
